notes.title: Published v.1.0 - First final release
notes.notes:
Hi, Just published update v.1.0 - First final release 

- All levels of immersive mode are now available (36 levels, 108 missions) 
- All levels of arcade mode are now available (6 levels)
- Fixed all the reported bug and other minor improvements.

The early access is over but we're happy to continue improving the game and fixing all the problems reported in the game forums: http://steamcommunity.com/app/639270/discussions/

PS: We're specially excited about the upcoming cooperative multiplayer game mode. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Published update v.0.9 - Special Grenades
notes.notes:
Hi, Just published update v.0.9 - Special Grenades
- All story mode levels already available.
- New weapon: Gravity shield.
- New weapon: Shotgun. 
- New weapon: Rocket launcher. 
- New Anti-Gravity grenades.  
- New Fire tornado grenades.
- New Ice grenades.
- New levitation rock grenades.
- New Bullet time grenades.
- New Fire blast grenades.
- New immersion point where you drive one helicopter. Yes! You drive it.
- Now optionally you can throw knives in a simpler way: Simply shoot
- New immersion point capsules icons.
- Improved the driving of airplanes. Now you can set the speed.
- Improved the driving of vehicles. Now you can use reverse.
- New immersion points where you shoot from a moving vehicle
- New immersion points where you shoot Taking off from a helicopter.
- New Dynamic Sounds for Collisions.
- The explosions has been improved graphically.
- Now you can reset your room scale place inside the vehicles.
- New visual indicator for the x5,x10,x15 and x20.
- New destructible lights.
- Cool graphic effect when you die in a immersion point.
- The game is now compatible with mixed reality. 
- Fixed all the reported bug and other minor improvements.

We're happy to continue improving the game and fixing all the problems reported in the game forums: http://steamcommunity.com/app/639270/discussions/

Next week we'll back with new features and surprises. Stay tunned!
